zh.summary: Aventix 是一家瑞典生命科学仪器公司，其首款产品 Scarlett 01 是用于微孔板液体体积测量的台式光学分析系统，旨在为实验室提供高精度、可追溯的测量数据以支撑 AI 与生物分析。
zh.judgment: Aventix 以硬件切入实验室数据质量瓶颈，但当前证据仅支持产品技术验证，尚未证明付费需求、单位经济或规模化采用。
zh.replaces: 替代传统目视移液器检查、间歇性体积验证以及依赖人工判断的微孔板体积质控流程。
zh.segment: 生命科学实验室仪器与生物分析数据质量工具。
zh.product: Aventix 的产品是 Scarlett 01 体积分析系统，基于其专利待审的 Aventix Chromatic Core Technology（ACCT），利用多色光色散与光谱分析进行非接触式液面高度测量，再通过 AI 模型将高度换算为体积。系统支持 96、384、1536 孔板及深孔板，测量范围覆盖 3 µL 至 300+ µL，单板扫描时间从 30 秒到 360 秒不等。配套的 SensVue 浏览器软件提供热图可视化、异常标记、CSV/JSON/Excel 导出及 REST API 与 WebSocket 接口。官网称该产品已通过芬兰国家计量研究所 VTT MIKES 的独立验证，在 10 µL DMSO 384 孔板测试中所有测量值在标定体积 ±5% 以内。
zh.customer: 目标用户是制药、化学、农业和化妆品研发实验室中负责高通量筛选、化合物制备、NGS 文库构建或细胞实验的科学家与实验室经理。付费者可能是实验室负责人或采购部门，其核心痛点是移液误差导致实验失败、试剂浪费和不可重复数据，且传统目视检查无法在实验早期发现微小偏差。官网未披露具体客户名称、付费规模或采购频率，因此无法判断痛点频率与预算归属。
zh.workflow: 用户将微孔板放入 Scarlett 01，仪器以非接触方式扫描全板，通过 ACCT 获取每个孔的液面高度点云数据；SensVue 的 AI 模型实时分析弯月面几何、板型与表面张力，将高度转换为体积，并生成颜色编码的热图与异常标记。用户可在浏览器中查看结果，导出 CSV、JSON 或 Excel 文件，或通过 REST API 将数据接入实验室自动化系统。整个流程无需消耗品或校准液，单板测量在数十秒至数分钟内完成。
zh.business_model: 官网仅提供“Request a Quote”入口，未公开定价、订阅费或服务协议价格。已知信息包括 12 个月标准保修和可购买的服务协议，但具体收费方式、硬件售价、软件授权模式均未披露。因此无法推断单位经济，任何关于毛利率、客户获取成本或经常性收入的讨论都缺乏证据。
zh.traction: 公司披露 Scarlett 01 已启动 Early Access Program，并与荷兰、比利时、卢森堡的 Wilten Instrumenten 建立非独家分销合作。官网还展示了 VTT MIKES 的独立验证摘要，但未披露已安装客户数量、收入、复购率或活跃使用数据。融资新闻稿称本轮资金将用于扩大 Early Access Program 的推广，但未给出具体采用指标。
zh.moat: Aventix 的潜在壁垒在于 ACCT 光学测量技术、AI 体积换算模型以及 VTT MIKES 的第三方验证，这些组合使其区别于通用 AI 模型或纯软件方案。然而，硬件仪器领域存在成熟竞争对手，且技术专利尚在申请中，壁垒是否可持续取决于测量精度能否在更多液体与板型上保持、分销网络能否快速铺开，以及客户是否愿意为数据质量支付溢价。
zh.funding_read: 本轮为 120 万欧元融资，投资方包括 Kost Capital、Voima Ventures 和 Bodil Sidén，轮次类型为 Other，未披露具体阶段。资金将用于扩大 Scarlett 01 的 Early Access Program，但资金用途的详细分配、下一里程碑的具体指标均未公开。该融资说明公司处于早期商业化阶段，但不足以证明产品已获得市场验证或收入增长。
zh.risks: 第一，若目标实验室不愿为体积测量硬件单独付费，或认为现有移液器校准流程已足够，Scarlett 01 可能面临需求不足。第二，若 ACCT 技术在其他液体（如高粘度、易挥发或含表面活性剂样品）或极端板型下精度下降，独立验证的适用范围将受限，影响客户信任。第三，分销合作若无法转化为实际订单，Early Access Program 可能停留在试点阶段。
zh.takeaway: Aventix 的案例表明，在 AI 生物分析热潮中，解决上游数据采集的物理精度问题可能比训练更大模型更具杠杆效应。创业者可借鉴其以第三方计量机构验证建立信任、以非接触式硬件降低使用门槛、以软件导出与 API 嵌入现有工作流的做法。
zh.watch_next: 下一步应关注 Scarlett 01 是否公布具体客户案例、安装数量或收入数据；是否披露定价与软件授权模式；以及 ACCT 技术是否在更多液体类型和板型上获得独立验证。

en.summary: Aventix is a Swedish life science instrumentation company whose first product, Scarlett 01, is a benchtop optical volume measurement system for microplates, designed to provide high-precision, traceable data for AI and bioanalytics.
en.judgment: Aventix addresses the upstream data quality bottleneck in life science AI with hardware, but current evidence only supports technical validation, not paid demand, unit economics, or scaled adoption.
en.replaces: Replaces manual visual pipette checks, intermittent volume verification, and human-judgment-based microplate volume QC workflows.
en.segment: Life science laboratory instrumentation and bioanalytics data quality tools.
en.product: Aventix's product is the Scarlett 01 Volume Analysis System, built on its patent-pending Aventix Chromatic Core Technology (ACCT), which uses polychromatic light dispersion and spectral analysis for non-contact liquid surface height measurement, then applies AI models to convert height to volume. It supports 96-, 384-, and 1536-well plates plus deep-well plates, with volume ranges from 3 µL to 300+ µL and scan times from 30 to 360 seconds per plate. The companion SensVue browser-based software provides heatmap visualization, anomaly flagging, CSV/JSON/Excel export, and REST API plus WebSocket interfaces. The company claims independent validation by VTT MIKES, Finland's National Metrology Institute, showing all measured values within ±5% of the calibrated volume for 10 µL DMSO in a 384-well plate.
en.customer: Target users are scientists and lab managers in pharmaceutical, chemical, agricultural, and cosmetic R&D labs performing high-throughput screening, compound preparation, NGS library prep, or cell-based assays. Payers are likely lab heads or procurement, and the core pain is pipetting errors causing failed experiments, reagent waste, and irreproducible data, which visual checks cannot catch early. The website does not disclose specific customer names, payment scale, or purchase frequency, so pain frequency and budget ownership cannot be assessed.
en.workflow: A user places a microplate into Scarlett 01, which scans the entire plate non-contact, capturing liquid surface height point cloud data via ACCT. SensVue's AI model analyzes meniscus geometry, plate type, and surface tension in real time, converting height to volume and generating color-coded heatmaps with anomaly flags. Users view results in a browser, export CSV, JSON, or Excel files, or integrate data into lab automation via REST API. The process requires no consumables or calibration liquids and completes in tens of seconds to minutes per plate.
en.business_model: The website only offers a 'Request a Quote' entry point and does not disclose pricing, subscription fees, or service agreement costs. Known elements include a 12-month standard warranty and purchasable service agreements, but hardware pricing, software licensing, and revenue model are undisclosed. Unit economics cannot be inferred, and any discussion of gross margin, customer acquisition cost, or recurring revenue lacks evidence.
en.traction: The company reports that Scarlett 01 has launched an Early Access Program and established a non-exclusive distribution partnership with Wilten Instrumenten for Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg. The website also presents a VTT MIKES independent validation summary, but does not disclose installed customer count, revenue, repeat purchase rates, or active usage data. The funding announcement states the round will scale the Early Access Program rollout but provides no specific adoption metrics.
en.moat: Aventix's potential moat lies in its ACCT optical measurement technology, AI volume conversion models, and third-party validation by VTT MIKES, which differentiate it from generic AI models or pure software solutions. However, the hardware instrumentation space has established competitors, and patents are still pending. Whether the moat is sustainable depends on maintaining measurement accuracy across more liquids and plate types, rapidly expanding distribution, and whether customers will pay a premium for data quality.
en.funding_read: This is a €1.2 million funding round with investors including Kost Capital, Voima Ventures, and Bodil Sidén, classified as Other stage with no specific stage disclosed. Funds will scale the Early Access Program for Scarlett 01, but detailed allocation and next milestone metrics are not public. The round indicates an early commercialization stage but does not prove market validation or revenue growth.
en.risks: First, if target labs are unwilling to pay separately for volume measurement hardware or consider existing pipette calibration sufficient, Scarlett 01 may face insufficient demand. Second, if ACCT accuracy degrades with other liquids (e.g., high-viscosity, volatile, or surfactant-containing samples) or extreme plate types, the scope of independent validation narrows, affecting customer trust. Third, if distribution partnerships fail to convert into actual orders, the Early Access Program may remain a pilot.
en.takeaway: Aventix's case suggests that in the AI bioanalytics boom, solving upstream physical data acquisition precision may be more leveraged than training larger models. Entrepreneurs can learn from its use of third-party metrology validation to build trust, non-contact hardware to lower adoption barriers, and software export plus APIs to embed into existing workflows.
en.watch_next: Next, watch whether Scarlett 01 discloses specific customer cases, installed base, or revenue data; whether pricing and software licensing models are revealed; and whether ACCT technology gains independent validation across more liquid types and plate formats.

Scarlett | 01 — Aventix Volume Measurement System Home Scarlett About News Careers Files Contact Get a Quote ☰ Aventix · Volume Measurement System Scarlett | 01 See every µL. The benchtop instrument that catches the errors you can't see — before they ruin your experiment. Request a Quote → How It Works The Problem You ran the assay twice. The data still doesn't make sense. Pipetting errors are the leading source of failed and irreproducible experiments. They're invisible to the naked eye, rarely caught before the damage is done, and they cost labs thousands in wasted reagents, time, and trust. Liquid handling errors directly affect compound concentrations, assay reproducibility, and downstream data quality. Conventional pipette checks are visual and intermittent — errors often go undetected until an experiment fails. Scarlett gives you instant, quantitative confirmation after every dispense, catching deviations before they cost you time, reagents, and results. Here's what independent validation of Scarlett at 10 µL looks like: 10.12 µL Calibrated target volume in independent validation study –0.2% to +2.7% Full error range across all measured wells Validation Summary VS-001 · Independent verification conducted by VTT MIKES, National Metrology Institute of Finland · Syringe calibrated by RISE Research Institutes of Sweden per ISO 8655 3rd-party validated Independent verification at 10 µL volumes Aventix Chromatic Core Technology ACCT How do you achieve contactless volume measurement with sub-micron resolution? The answer is light. 01 Chromatic Dispersion Polychromatic light. Split. Focused. Precise. Polychromatic light is passed through a proprietary multi-lens system. Chromatic aberration — normally an optical flaw — is instead used as a tool. The lens stack intentionally splits white light into discrete wavelengths, each focused at a precisely calibrated distance from the sensor. The result is a continuous rainbow of focal points — a ruler made of light, spanning from the well rim to the liquid surface with sub-micron resolution. 02 Spectral Analysis The reflected wavelength reveals the height. Only the wavelength in focus at the liquid surface reflects back with maximum intensity. The spectrometer analyzes the reflected light and identifies the peak wavelength — and since every wavelength maps to a precise distance, the peak wavelength directly encodes the surface height. 03 AI Volume Computation Height becomes volume. AI handles the physics. Converting liquid height to volume is non-trivial. Scarlett supports two approaches depending on your application. A calibration curve method correlates measured height profiles with known volumes for a given liquid and plate combination, delivering high accuracy where a reference curve exists. A geometric calculation method — which derives volume directly from measured well geometry and liquid height — offers a path for use cases where calibration data is not available. Both approaches leverage Scarlett's AI to compensate for meniscus curvature and surface tension effects. The result is a highly accurate volume figure for every well — delivered in seconds, across every well format Scarlett supports. ACCT is the core technology behind Scarlett — patent pending, built entirely by Aventix. Request a Technical Briefing → SensVue AI Engine Advanced AI. Precise volume. Real results. Scarlett's AI engine doesn't just measure — it understands. Deep learning models analyze meniscus geometry in real time, dynamically compensating for liquid curvature, plate geometry and surface tension to deliver unmatched volume accuracy across all well conditions.
